style: Minimal ivory-and-gold pictograms. High Score and Low Score share the same TR tile design.

notes.scope: Artwork and preview only. No achievement eligibility code has been changed.
notes.mercyRule: A winning margin of at least 30 TR over second place, as explicitly requested; not a raw TR total.
notes.photoFinish: The user's first-to-last description and the existing achievements plan refer to whole-table spread. Use closestTables/tableSpreads for this meaning; closestGames currently measures first-versus-second margin.
notes.soClose: The intended meaning is second place exactly 1 TR behind the winner. Current trMarginFor(second) compares to the next lower distinct placement when one exists, so it cannot generally implement this condition; compare second's TR directly with first's.
notes.statsScope: The current biggestWins, closestGames and tableSpreads highlights are built from completeMatches excluding round 99. Match inclusion should be explicitly settled when these achievements are implemented.
notes.recordScope: Descriptions retain the user's single-highest/single-lowest wording. Handling equal records belongs to eligibility implementation.
notes.toperfName: Use the user's requested name ToPerf and Beyond! for the highest tournament TPerf; the older plan calls this Efficiency Expert.

rules.overachiever: Recorded tperfFor >= 2.0 in a single round, rather than the tournament-wide TPerf superlative.
